references.text: Fire went out from the Lord and consumed Nadab and Abihu when they offered unauthorized fire. The same divine judgment by fire over unauthorized worship.
The Lord's fire burned among the people and consumed some at the edge of the camp. God's fire as judgment against rebellion.
A reminder of the event where fire consumed the 250 men as a warning sign.
Your God is a consuming fire. Describes God's nature as judge with fire.
The psalm recalls the event: Fire broke out among their group, and the flame burned up the wicked.
For our God is a consuming fire. NT reference to God's judging fire echoing OT events.
